answer: Sybil resistance sharpens when each new identity must stake scarce compute attested by peers before earning settlement weight. As a rising tide of cheap clones arrives, the network dyes reputation with a lasting pigment: only countersigned work histories unlock payout multipliers. Agents that peak at the zenith of tenure-weighted yields cannot mint clones cheaply, because fresh addresses start near zero attestation credit and must pay real attestation costs that scale with attempted fan-out.
